policy: Use exactly one canonical diagnosis code from the predicted category. Codes name the primary root cause, not a downstream symptom. Do not invent aliases.

expression.definition: Expression-like text lacks the leading equals sign required to evaluate it.
An expression references a node name that is absent from the supplied workflow and the evidence does not establish a safe replacement source; do not invent a node name.
Expression reads a property path that does not match the supplied JSON input.
Expression calls a method unavailable for the receiver or uses incorrect method casing.
Expression has invalid syntax, such as a missing operand or delimiter.
Native Date methods are confused with n8n's Luxon DateTime expression API.

data_mapping.definition: The required source property is genuinely absent or null at the intended path; the payload does not contain a supported alternative value path.
Selected array index does not correspond to the requested item.
A value mapped within the workflow has the wrong type for the explicit receiving field contract; this is not an HTTP API request-schema field mismatch.
Logical OR replaces valid falsy values such as zero; nullish coalescing is required.
Text such as false is treated as truthy rather than parsed explicitly.
The requested value is present in the supplied payload at a different nested JSON path than the expression reads; this is not an absent or null source field.

item_linking.definition: The .item reference cannot uniquely identify one item among multiple upstream items; use first()/last() only when supplied ordering or evidence establishes the intended item, otherwise request review.
A one-to-one Code node transformation creates new output items but omits pairedItem metadata entirely, so n8n cannot link outputs to their corresponding inputs.
First or last selects the wrong item based on the explicit ordering and requirement.
first() selects one item when the workflow requires all returned items.
An expression refers to the wrong source node even though the actual connected upstream node is explicitly present in the workflow and can be identified from the supplied graph.
Paired-item lineage is absent or unavailable and the supplied evidence does not establish a unique safe key, ordering or one-to-one mapping; abstain and request human review.

node_configuration.definition: Configured HTTP method contradicts the explicit endpoint contract.
Body data is configured but sendBody is disabled.
Response format conflicts with the downstream data requirement.
Timeout option has an invalid type or representation.
A numeric timeout is demonstrably below an explicit endpoint response-time requirement supplied in the task; only then is a bounded timeout correction supported.
Wait node duration differs from the explicitly requested delay.

workflow_structure.definition: Connection points to a node name not present in the workflow.
IF node true and false output targets are swapped.
A required source branch is not connected to its Merge node input.
Existing downstream node is unreachable because a required edge is absent.
Connection references an output index invalid for the source node.

code_node.definition: Run Once for All Items returns one object instead of an array of output items.
Code node output items do not wrap their data inside a json property.
Configured Code node execution mode conflicts with the APIs and output shape used by the script.
Script references a variable not declared or available in the current item context.
Code node returns primitive values instead of n8n item objects.
A pairedItem reference is present but points to the wrong source input index or fails to preserve the correct relationship after reordering/filtering; this is distinct from missing metadata.

execution_api.definition: API confirms a retryable rate limit but the node lacks explicitly supported bounded retry settings.
API identifies a missing or incorrect request key present in the supplied input.
An HTTP request body field violates the explicitly supplied external API schema type, such as sending numeric text where the API requires an integer.
Remote 5xx outage is evidenced without a safe workflow-only correction.
DNS or connection failure is evidenced without proof of a workflow parameter fault.

A request timeout is observed, but no verified endpoint response-time requirement or owner-approved timeout value proves that the configured timeout is too short; do not guess a larger value and request human review.

credentials.definition: Provider rejects configured authentication; credential owner must verify it.
Authenticated identity lacks required provider permission or scope.
Credentialed operation has no selected credential reference.
Provider reports expired OAuth authorization requiring owner reauthorization.
Provider rejects or reports an unavailable API key; model must not guess a replacement.
Required secret is redacted or unavailable, so no safe secret-related patch is possible.

abstention_rules: All credentials category cases require patch=[] and needs_human_review=true.
Do not patch a provider outage or DNS/network failure without evidence of a workflow-side cause.
Do not guess an item selection when paired-item lineage or a stable join key is missing.
Never modify credentials or secret values.
